author: Andrew Gamble
title: Audi Crooks heroics help Iowa State inflict pain on Caitlin Clark's former team - NewsBreak
text:
By Andrew Gamble ,
1 hours ago Audi Crooks decimated Iowa with a 30-point display to end Iowa State’s losing run against their rivals.
The college basketball star and favorite women's college hooper of Pat McAfee has been in electric form across the 2025-26 season. Last month, Crooks set the program record with 47 points versus Indiana — and she continued her tear against Iowa while her Iowa State remained unbeaten.
This was a fixture that was once dominated by Caitlin Clark. The WNBA superstar went off for 19 and 35 points in two games across the Hawkeyes’ dominant run against the Cyclones, but Crooks has put a stop to that.

• A'ja Wilson came to important realization after 'biggest fight' with Dawn Staley
With Clark long gone, Iowa had no answer for Iowa State’s phenomenal center. On Wednesday, Iowa State moved to 11-0 with a 74-69 win over its rivals at Hilton Coliseum, with Crooks putting up 30 points with 10 rebounds.
It was the first real test by a non-conference opponent, but No. 10 Iowa State posted a marquee victory over No. 11 Iowa. Addy Brown added 20 points, while she also finished with 12 rebounds and five assists.
The Cyclones led by 17 points late in the third quarter before Iowa went on a remarkable 26-12 run to spark comeback hopes and make it a three-point game late in the second half. The Hawkeyes had a chance to tie it, but Mackenzie Hare blocked Taylor McCabe's 3-point attempt with 16 seconds left.

Crooks then made a free throw to make it 73-69 and secure her fourth 30-point game of the season. It was the 20-year-old’s 78th-straight double-figure game — the longest active streak in the nation.
She has now scored 20 or more points in nine of 11 games this season.
Remarkably, the win was Crooks’ fifth career 30-point, 10-rebound game. She trails only former Virginia Tech star Elizabeth Kitley (6) and USC phenom JuJu Watkins (7) for the most in DI since the start of the 2023-24 season.
Crooks' career total of 20-plus point games is now brought to 50, while her 30-plus point career total stands at 12. The performance was her third double-double of the season.
Iowa simply had no answer for Crooks, who was nearly unstoppable when she caught entry passes into the post. Many of those came from Jada Williams, who had a career-high 12 assists alongside 11 points and five rebounds.
The rolling Cyclones are next in action against 4-5 Northern Iowa on Sunday, Dec. 14.
